entities.name: From the Library of Leng
entities.description: A column in The Duelist magazine (later Duelist Online) giving a story, sample decklist and artist's view for a featured card.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: A Human thief who gained immortality by stealing a tome from Castle Sengir and became King of Ulgrotha's Goblins.

entities.name: Bernatheen
entities.description: A wizard for whom Eron stole a magical tome.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: The castle from which Eron stole a magical tome.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane whose Goblins Eron rules, isolated by Feroz.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A forest spirit who gained sentience when Feroz isolated Ulgrotha and who tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A planeswalker who isolated the plane of Ulgrotha from the rest of the Multiverse; his Ban later failed.

entities.name: An-Havva
entities.description: Home of the folk Autumn Willow tries to save from Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: An immortal vampire lord whose cruelty is sanitised in an in-universe biography.

entities.name: Lord of Tresserhorn
entities.description: Regent for the Necromancer Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer for whom the Lord of Tresserhorn is regent.

entities.name: Verduran Enchantress
entities.description: A resident of the idyllic island of Verdura, whose inhabitants follow a powerful Avatar.

entities.name: Verdura
entities.description: An idyllic island inhabited almost exclusively by women who adhere to a powerful unnamed Avatar.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An Angel planeswalker whose shrine at Epityr is the subject of a column.

entities.name: Epityr
entities.description: Site of the shrine to Serra.

entities.name: Goblin Recruiter
entities.description: Featured in a column taking the form of a field guide to Goblins.

entities.name: Suq'Ata Assassin
entities.description: Subject of the first Duelist Online column; the Suq'Ata come from Rabiah the Infinite and are organised in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: Assassins originating on Rabiah the Infinite and now organised in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Rabiah the Infinite
entities.description: Plane of origin of the Suq'Ata.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Where the Suq'Ata are currently organised.

entities.name: Clockwork Gnomes
entities.description: Inhabitants of a distant island on which a pirate ship becomes stranded, in the Phyrexian Dreadnought and Prismatic Circle column.

events.summary: Eron the Relentless steals a magical tome from Castle Sengir for Bernatheen, gains immortality, and rises to become King of Ulgrotha's Goblins.
events.quote: the Human thief Eron gained immortality after stealing a magical tome from Castle Sengir for the wizard Bernatheen

events.summary: Feroz isolates Ulgrotha, giving Autumn Willow sentience; later Feroz's Ban fails and she tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.
events.quote: gained sentience after the planeswalker Feroz isolated the plane of Ulgrotha from the rest of the Multiverse

events.summary: A column presents a sanitised biography of Baron Sengir, dismissing his cruelty as pragmatism.
events.quote: His positive attributes are talked up, while actions that would otherwise be seen as cruel or evil are dismissed as unimportant or simple pragmatism.

events.summary: The Lord of Tresserhorn's typical night as Regent for the Necromancer Lim-Dûl is described.
events.quote: It describes a typical night for Lord of Tresserhorn

events.summary: A column gives an overview of Verdura and its inhabitants' adherence to a powerful Avatar.
events.quote: It offers a brief overview of the idyllic island of Verdura

events.summary: A found sea chest holds a journal about a pirate ship stranded on an island of Clockwork Gnomes.
events.quote: details the finding of a sea chest containing a journal

events.summary: A column gives a history of the shrine to the Angel planeswalker Serra at Epityr.
events.quote: It gives a history of the shrine to the Angel planeswalker Serra at Epityr .

events.summary: A column gives background on the Suq'Ata, their origins on Rabiah the Infinite and their organisation in Jamuraa.
events.quote: their origins on the plane of Rabiah the Infinite

relations.quote: then rose to become the King of Ulgrotha 's Goblins

relations.note: She tries to save the folk of An-Havva from him.
relations.quote: she finds her powers slipping while she tries to save the folk of An-Havva from the Baron Sengir
